steps.summary: Large blue oval sign with white text reading 'Panasonic'
Tall cream/beige colored building with multiple stories and a distinctive rounded top, bearing the Panasonic sign
Large gray brutalist apartment or office tower on the left side with repetitive horizontal striped pattern
Wide multi-lane urban avenue with white lane markings and directional arrows
Multiple cars including a silver sedan in the foreground on the roadway
Traffic lights visible in the street scene
Illuminated billboard or advertisement on top of left building with partially visible text and images
Multiple mid-rise buildings in European classical style lining the avenue
Grassy median or plaza area in the center of the avenue
Overcast or hazy sky with minimal cloud detail
Street lights and poles along the avenue

The Spanish-language billboard text 'Ovejas menos seguro pagas' (e12) confirms Spanish-speaking country. The wide multi-lane avenue with grassy median (e4, e9), classical European-style mid-rise buildings (e8), and the iconic Panasonic sign atop a building are all characteristic of Avenida 9 de Julio in Buenos Aires, a famous landmark known for large advertising signs on its buildings.
